result.title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
result.summary: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9% against a same-shape neutral control (4,252 ms to 131 ms) and raised single-dispatch completion from 69.4% to 95.8%. In a separate 27-decision end-to-end replication with live local TCP/HTTP execution, OpenTelemetry client spans, and Toxiproxy-injected faults, verified state reduced mean regret from 8,956 ms to 0 ms (zero excess observable operational cost) and completed the live action in 9/9 model-by-fault cases versus 5/9 for the neutral control. These studies establish the tools-and-network instance of Agent Harness Awareness: selected host telemetry materially improves pre-dispatch operational choice. Runtime state, hardware pressure, economics, retry-aware recovery, and heterogeneous selection remain open empirical extensions of the same architecture.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Agent Harness Awareness：在关键动作前由宿主向工具调用 agent 注入小规模、新鲜且经验证的状态快照，并用 ToolRoute 隔离基准及三个模型上的 216 次决策实验检验其对决策后悔和单次完成率的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「宿主提供经验证状态、保留测量与最终放行权」的信任分离设计，可能为 LVR 中如何向推理过程注入可信外部证据、以及依据证据做停止或放行决策提供概念参照，但论文无视觉或多模态内容，迁移性尚需核查。
